scenes.vo: Still typing *payment reminders* by hand, one customer at a time?

params.quote: shall exceed forty-five days from the day of acceptance

scenes.vo: Every Monday, forty of them. But Indian law gives small suppliers *45 days* to get paid. So most chase it by hand.

params.query: person typing on laptop at night
params.label: per reply

scenes.vo: Each reminder is typed from *scratch*. But the reply comes days *later*. Until you start again. Your whole Monday goes.
Here is the same Monday job, done *by hand*, then done *automatically*.
So each morning the unpaid list is *read*. A reminder is *written*. Each customer gets *one*, with their name and amount.
At ten every morning, it runs on its own. Nobody types a word. Nobody forgets a name.
So reminders your team still types by hand this week: *zero*. The Monday pile is gone, for good.
